Because I am a read-only subagent, I cannot modify your filesystem. Please use your `write_to_file` tool to save the following code to `C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\blender\cloth_sim.py`.

```python
import bpy
import math

def setup_scene():
    # Clear existing scene
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
    bpy.ops.object.delete()

    # 1. Create Pole
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.1, depth=10, location=(0, 0, 5))
    pole = bpy.context.active_object
    pole.name = "Pole"
    # Add collision so the flag doesn't pass through the pole
    pole.modifiers.new(name="Collision", type='COLLISION')

    # 2. Create Flag (Cloth)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_grid_add(x_subdivisions=60, y_subdivisions=60, size=2, location=(2.1, 0, 9))
    flag = bpy.context.active_object
    flag.name = "Flag"
    
    # Rotate 90 degrees on X to stand it vertically
    flag.rotation_euler = (math.radians(90), 0, 0)
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=True, scale=False)
    bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()

    # 3. Pinning (Left Edge)
    vg = flag.vertex_groups.new(name="Pin")
    # Grid size is 2, local x goes from -1 to 1. Pin vertices on the far left.
    pinned_verts = [v.index for v in flag.data.vertices if v.co.x < -0.95]
    vg.add(pinned_verts, 1.0, 'ADD')

    # 4. Cloth Modifier
    cloth = flag.modifiers.new(name="Cloth", type='CLOTH')
    cloth.settings.vertex_group_mass = "Pin"
    cloth.collision_settings.use_self_collision = True
    
    # Set cache duration
    cloth.point_cache.frame_start = 1
    cloth.point_cache.frame_end = 150

    # 5. Wind Force Field
    bpy.ops.object.effector_add(type='WIND', location=(-3, 0, 9), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
    wind = bpy.context.active_object
    wind.name = "Wind"
    wind.field.strength = 1500
    wind.field.noise = 5.0

    # 6. Camera Setup
    bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(2, -12, 9), rotation=(math.radians(90), 0, 0))
    cam = bpy.context.active_object
    bpy.context.scene.camera = cam

    # 7. Light Setup
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN', location=(5, -5, 12), rotation=(math.radians(45), 0, math.radians(45)))
    sun = bpy.context.active_object
    sun.data.energy = 3.0

    # 8. Setup Animation & Render Engine
    bpy.context.scene.frame_start = 1
    bpy.context.scene.frame_end = 150
    
    # Render Settings
    render = bpy.context.scene.render
    render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'
    # Save PNG sequence to cloth_render directory (ensuring a trailing slash/backslash for directory rendering)
    render.filepath = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\blender\cloth_render\\"
    
    # 9. Bake the Simulation
    print("Baking cloth simulation...")
    bpy.ops.ptcache.bake_all(bake=True)
    print("Bake complete! You can now render the animation sequence.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    setup_scene()
```
